verdict.rationale: Datadog is a SaaS platform that handles customer telemetry and ships AI features, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a training opt-out, a data-usage policy for model training, or a related privacy control. The sensitive-data evaluation flag (datadog-docs-21) detects regulated information in LLM inputs and outputs, which is a different feature from preventing training use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
